items.topic: 隐私交易的广播与断言
items.title: ethresear.ch：严格角色交替，EVM 屏蔽池的无 relayer 互惠广播
items.note: 14:07（atoranzo，仅规范和模拟）。屏蔽池依赖 relayer，因为 `msg.sender` 必须用有资金的透明账户付 gas；文中引用的 Railgun 测量显示，1,049 笔自行广播的提款通过 gas 付款方与存款人关联，124 个类 relayer 地址承担 89% 的代转量。提案在每个 note 的承诺中加入角色位，让用户相互代为广播。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: strict role alternation, reciprocal broadcast without relayers for EVM shielded pools
items.note_en: 14:07 (atoranzo, spec and simulation only). Shielded pools depend on relayers because `msg.sender` must pay gas from a funded transparent account; the cited Railgun measurement shows 1,049 self-broadcast withdrawals linked to their depositor through the gas payer and 124 relayer-like addresses serving 89% of relayed volume. The proposal adds a role bit to each note commitment so users broadcast for one another.

items.topic: 隐私交易的广播与断言
items.title: EIP-7906：按 topic 值的事件视图（TXDIFF 0x0B/0x0C）
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil，21 日合并）。保护用户的断言要按用户身份筛选事件，比如所有 `from` 是该用户的 `Transfer`；动态路由下签名时不知道哪些合约会发事件，按发出地址索引就不够用。
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil, merged on the 21st). An assertion protecting a user filters events by that user's identity, such as every `Transfer` whose `from` is the user; under dynamic routing the emitting contracts are unknown at signing time, so keying by emitter is not enough.

keywords_en: relayer-free reciprocal broadcast for shielded pools
summary_en: A quiet Saturday. An ethresear proposal uses a "role bit" inside each note commitment so shielded pool users broadcast for one another, replacing the relayer market; it cites a June Railgun measurement where 1,049 self-broadcast withdrawals were linked to their depositor through the gas payer and 124 relayer-like addresses served 89% of relayed volume. EIP-7906 submitted event views keyed by topic value (merged on the 21st), making it easier to write transaction assertions by user identity.
